# Repository review context

Follow AGENTS.md and its linked governance documents. Review changed code and
Markdown documentation against the applicable adopted policy, not just style.
Read the relevant source before making a policy-based finding. If a referenced
policy, private companion, submodule or company original is unavailable, state
that limitation; do not claim it was checked or invent its requirements.

Keep policy rules authoritative in their existing documents. Distinguish adopted
owner decisions, proposed implementation text, historical evidence and current
verification. Work-branch text and review drafts do not become adopted policy
merely because this PR contains them. For changes to policy, compare with the
base revision and the recorded owner decision instead of validating the proposal
solely against itself.

Give actionable findings tied to a changed passage, explain the consequence and
cite the applicable document and section. Avoid repeating a finding across files
or presenting stylistic preferences as policy violations. Use English for GitHub
review comments, preserving Japanese quotations where necessary.
